name: lazarus
description: Proof-checked historical Ethereum fixtures with deterministic exact-request replay and no live fallback.

interface.longDescription: Lazarus captures the finite historical Ethereum state and exact JSON-RPC evidence one application test needs, checks account and storage claims through EIP-1186 against the named header, writes deterministic digest-bound fixture files and replays only exact captured requests over loopback. Calls, receipts, logs and traces remain labelled recorded evidence, and an uncaptured request fails visibly without a live provider fallback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $lazarus to capture, verify or replay this finite historical Ethereum fixture without a live replay fallback.
